title: 地热发电
prompt: Describe how the geothermal station uses underground heat to produce electricity. Follow the five labelled stages; retain labels as shown.
book_ref: 剑雅 12 Academic · Test 4 · Writing Task 1

stages: Cold water is pumped down an injection well, 4.5 km underground
Water passes through the geothermal zone of hot rocks
Heated water is pumped up a production well
At the surface, the unit labelled condenser produces steam
Steam drives a turbine and generator; electricity goes to the grid

source_status: 题意和事实单独核对；指导由编者撰写，不转载外部范文。
